subject: ISV co-sell pact: DataForge listing + entitlement & evidence checklist
messages:
From: Alice Chen <alice@dataforge.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Wilson <tom@dataforge.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Partnership ask — DataForge marketplace listing + co-sell

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for taking a look. I'm Alice, Head of Partnerships at DataForge. We build a data orchestration product that a number of mutual customers have asked us to bundle with Redwood's inference platform. We are evaluating listings on AWS Marketplace (Sell-With / Co-Sell), GCP Marketplace (co-sell support), and exploring a joint demo entitlement for field teams.

Before we schedule a kickoff, can you share Redwood's short checklist for:
- Security/compliance evidence (SOC 2, pen test summaries, data handling notes)
- Metering / SKU mapping guidance (how you expect us to report usage for sell-with)
- Demo / entitlement flow (trial credits, API key scoping, demo tenant access)
- Typical timelines for catalog review and co-sell enablement on AWS/GCP

I've attached a one-page partner brief to give context. Happy to hop on a call next week — Tom (cc'd) is our lead for marketplace ops.

Regards,
Alice Chen
Head of Partnerships, DataForge
attachments: dataforge-partner-brief.pdf
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice@dataforge.com>
Cc: Tom Wilson <tom@dataforge.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Partnership ask — DataForge marketplace listing + co-sell

Thanks Alice — really appreciate the brief. Short answers inline and a proposed next step:

Security/compliance:
- Baseline: SOC 2 Type II report (or in-process with expected date) + high-level pen test summary. For Private deployments we also ask for data flow diagrams.

Metering / SKU mapping:
- We typically map one SKU per offering tier and region. For sell-with we need a usage signal (consumption event) you can emit (e.g., API call counts or bytes processed). Our marketplace team prefers per-hour or per-1000-requests metrics.

Demo / entitlement:
- A short-lived demo tenant + API key with scoped quotas is ideal. Separately, a simple onboarding playbook for field demos (1-pager) helps us certify demo flows.

Timelines:
- Catalog review -> 2–4 weeks assuming evidence is complete; co-sell enablement on AWS can take 4–8 weeks depending on metering integration.

Proposed next step: 30-min kickoff to triage evidence and assign owners. I'm looping in Marissa (product partnerships / technical) and Ben (channel ops) to pick up technical/metering asks. Is Tue 11/17 10am PT workable (call link in follow-up)?

I'll attach our marketplace evidence template to make things easy.

Best,
Rishi
Director, Strategic Partners | Redwood Inference
attachments: marketplace-evidence-template.xlsx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice@dataforge.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Wilson <tom@dataforge.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 08:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Partnership ask — DataForge marketplace listing + co-sell

Thanks all — quick technical note ahead of the kickoff so the call is focused.

Starter evidence we will need (per-cloud specifics below):
- SOC 2 Type II (PDF) or a SOC readiness report + expected issuance date
- Pen test executive summary (redacted findings ok)
- Data processing addendum and data flow diagram (PNG/PDF)
- API docs + auth model + rate limiting behavior (we need to confirm metering event semantics)
- Demo tenant credentials (temporary) + sample dataset + instructions to seed the demo
- Statement of work for any managed services or co-delivery (if applicable)

Cloud-specific items:
- AWS (Sell-With / Co-Sell): we need a clear consumption metric you can surface to Marketplace (ideally CloudWatch metric or usage file). If you cannot emit a metric, provide a reliable proxy calculation and a reconciliation plan.
- GCP: provide the billing SKU mapping and any quota constraints; GCP co-sell often needs a validated demo that shows product interoperability end-to-end.

Operational asks (who does what):
- DataForge: deliver SOC/pen test, API docs, demo creds, and an initial mapping of candidate consumption events (due 11/24).
- Ben Carter (channel ops): will own SKU mapping and billing reconciliation with our marketplace team.
- Marissa: will validate demo + security evidence.

I recommend we run a 5-day evidence triage sprint once we receive the docs — that gives us a prioritized binder for the catalog team. I added a short checklist to the attached template so DataForge can populate quickly.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Manager, Product Partnerships | Redwood Inference
attachments: marketplace-evidence-template.xlsx (updated), evidence-checklist-onepager.pdf, dataforge-demo-credentials.txt
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Partnership ask — DataForge marketplace listing + co-sell

Great — thanks Marissa. Quick summary and next steps so everyone's aligned before the kickoff: 

Action items and owners:
- DataForge (Alice/Tom): populate the marketplace-evidence-template.xlsx with SOC/pen test dates, API docs link, demo creds, and consumption event proposal — due Tue 11/24.
- Ben Carter: map proposed consumption events to SKU constructs and confirm billing reconciliation approach by Mon 11/30.
- Marissa: run demo validation and security triage during triage sprint (11/25–11/29).
- Rishi: coordinate catalog review and schedule co-sell enablement window with cloud marketplaces once triage passes.

Call scheduled: Tue 11/17 10:00am PT — dial-in: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=call-DF-112-kickoff (please accept). I'll also send a DocuSign for a lightweight co-sell MOU (link below) to confirm go-to-market commitments post-triage.

DocuSign (pre-populated MOU): https://docusign.com/link/example-mou-DF-112
HubSpot record: https://hub.redwood/record/DF-2026-112

If DataForge prefers, we can split evidence delivery — security + API first (fast lane) and metering second — but the faster we get SOC/pen summaries and demo creds, the earlier we can start co-sell enablement.

Looking forward to the kickoff.

Best,
Rishi
Director, Strategic Partners | Redwood Inference
